provenance.note: Real IQ published by hcab14/TDoA in proc_tdoa_DCF77.m; GPL-3.0. Recorded in 2020, not live. Public time reference used for commissioning; this is not an amateur-radio beacon dataset.

evidence.note: The author explicitly associates these three files with DCF77. Identity comes from dataset provenance, not inferred position or frequency alone.

position_evidence.note: Receiver GNSS coordinates published by the author. Exact antenna position and cable delay are undocumented. The declared 1 km operational allowance is an assumption, not verified accuracy.
